subject: Structuring a modular observability add-on: retention tiers, trace SLA, and dashboard credits
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Halpern <sara.halpern@echohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Structuring a modular observability add-on: retention tiers, trace SLA, and dashboard credits

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our discussion I attached a very small price workbook that lays out two modular ways EchoHealth can buy observability add-ons (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards). The goal here is to make the buy flexible during your pilot and keep unit economics predictable if you scale.

High level proposal (pilot-friendly):
- Flex-Retain (pilot): 30-day hot + 90-day warm (configurable to 180) + cold archive at 365d optional
- Tracing SLA: 99.9% ingest/serve SLO, with a 90-day trace retention baseline and opt-in longer retention for compliance logs
- Advanced Dashboards: feature-tiered; pilot gets seatless viewer mode + 5 editors; pay-as-you-grow or commit seat bundle

Attached: price_workbook_v3.xlsx (tabbed: baseline pricing, retention scenarios, pilot credit math) and EchoHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub for pilot).

Asks from you so we can finalize numbers:
1) For retention, confirm whether you prefer the 90d warm or want us to price 180d warm for compliance logs.
2) Do you want seatless dashboards for the pilot (preferred) or seat-based pricing?
3) Procurement contact and preferred payment terms (we typically propose net-30 for pilots; enterprise net-45/60 can be discussed).

If you confirm (1–3) I’ll send a concise SOW + revised pricing sheet and can include a 3-month usage credit for the pilot to offset initial ingestion costs. Proposed next steps: review this week, sign SOW next week, pilot kickoff in early October.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: EchoHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: price_workbook_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sara Halpern <sara.halpern@echohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@echohealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structuring a modular observability add-on: retention tiers, trace SLA, and dashboard credits

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — the workbook was helpful. A few clarifications / asks from our side:

1) Retention needs: for regulatory reasons we need 180-day "warm" retention for certain trace groups (PII-related request traces). Can you price a 180d warm option (we understand this raises cost).
2) Dashboards: procurement is pushing for seatless pricing for viewers; we only want to pay for editors. Is there an option to remove viewer fees and provide a per-editor bundle?
3) Discounts & terms: procurement asked if Redwood can provide a 15% discount on the add-on list price for an initial 12-month commitment. They also prefer net-30 payment terms.

Also note: legal will want to see retention & deletion guarantees (we can share our internal compliance checklist). Finally — can you include audit log access for the tracing service (read-only export) as part of the pilot?

If you can get back to me with a concrete two-option pricing (our budget constraint vs. a committed option) I can run both to procurement and legal.

Best,
Sara
VP, Platform Engineering | EchoHealth
[Procurement: procurement@echohealth.com]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: EchoHealth retention + seatless dashboards — pricing options (need approval)

Ben / Jordan — forwarding Sara's reply. Key asks: 180d warm for some trace groups, seatless viewer model (pay only for editors), 15% discount on add-ons for 12-month commitment, net-30, and audit-log access during pilot.

I modeled two concession options in the attached price workbook and included the SOW stub. Short summary:

Option A (Commit + deeper discount)
- 12-month commitment for add-ons (retention + tracing + dashboards)
- 25% off list on add-ons (applies to retention & trace ingestion)
- 3 months of dashboard editor credits ($10k credit) applied at kickoff
- Audit log export included during pilot
- Seatless viewer model: included; editors sold as 5-editor bundle at $1,200/editor/mo after pilot (prorated)
- Rationale: larger discount requires committed ARR; offsets higher cost for 180d warm

Option B (Pilot-first, smaller concession)
- No long-term commit; 12% off list for first 6 months
- 3 months usage credit up to $25k for ingestion spikes
- Seatless viewer model for pilot only; editor bundles start after pilot at list
- Audit log export included but retention beyond pilot priced separately

Asks: Jordan — please confirm legal OK on net-30 for pilot and whether we can include audit log export in the pilot SOW. Ben — can you sign off on the discount bands (25% vs 12%) for a mid-market account? I want to keep flexibility to trade T&Cs for margin where appropriate.

I'll be on standby for edits. If both approve I’ll send Option A as a counteroffer to EchoHealth and share the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Vanessa
[Attachment: price_workbook_v3.xlsx (updated with scenarios)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Halpern <sara.halpern@echohealth.com>
Cc: procurement@echohealth.com, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structuring a modular observability add-on: retention tiers, trace SLA, and dashboard credits — Redwood counteroffer

Hi Sara —

Really appreciate the clarity. EchoHealth is a great fit for a pilot and we've carved a tailored counteroffer that balances your compliance ask with a subdued commercial commitment. Summary below (counteroffer = "Flex-Retain 180 Pilot"):

What we include (pilot):
- Retention: 30-day hot + 180-day warm (select trace groups per your policy) + optional 365d cold archive (cold billed separately if used)
- Tracing: baseline 90-day trace retention with add-on groups at 180d; Tracing SLA: 99.9% ingest/serve
- Dashboards: seatless viewer mode for the pilot; editors: 5 editor bundle included
- Audit logs: read-only export available during pilot (automated daily export for 90 days)

Commercials (two paths):
1) Pilot + Commit (recommended): 12-month add-on commitment; monthly price after 25% off list = $13,500/month (retention + tracing + dashboard bundle). We will apply a one-time dashboard credit equal to $10,000 (applied across first three invoices). Net-30 payment terms.
2) Pilot-only (low-commit): $15,300/month (12% off list for first 6 months) + up to $25k ingestion credit to help during pilot. After pilot, seat editor pricing reverts to list unless a commit is agreed. Net-30.

Why we think Option 1 is better: it gives EchoHealth predictable monthly economics while letting you get 180d warm for the traces you need. Option 2 keeps your flexibility but has a higher run-rate after the initial discount window.

Next steps:
- If procurement approves Option 1, we’ll issue an updated SOW (attached) and a DocuSign envelope. Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XX-echo-dslink-2026
- If you prefer Option 2, confirm and we’ll schedule kickoff with pilot credits applied.

Attachments: EchoHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (updated with Flex-Retain 180 language), price_workbook_v3.xlsx (updated numbers).

Can you confirm preferred path by end-of-week? Happy to hop on a 30-min call with procurement/legal to walk through retention guarantees and audit log handling.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0192
